newsitem.title: USA: General Growth buys Georgia shopping mall.
newsitem.headline: General Growth buys Georgia shopping mall.

text.p: General Growth Properties Inc, which owns and operates shopping centers, on Thursday said it acquired Southlake Mall near Atlanta, for about $67 million.
The price includes about $10.4 million in cash, $11.5 million of operating partnership units and about $45.1 million in debt that matures later this year, the real estate investment trust said.
The property is expected to produce about $6.5 million of net operating income during the next 12 months, General Growth said.
General Growth shares were unchanged at 32-5/8 Thursday.
